import os, hashlib, json
def dir_hashes(d):
    out = {}
    for root, _, files in os.walk(d):
        for f in sorted(files):
            p = os.path.join(root, f)
            with open(p, 'rb') as fh:
                out[os.path.relpath(p, d)] = hashlib.sha256(fh.read()).hexdigest()[:16]
    return out
